endpoints.label: List UCSC genome assemblies
endpoints.describes: All UCSC-hosted assemblies (hg38, mm10, danRer11, …). Use to discover available reference frames + assembly names before querying tracks.

endpoints.label: List tracks for a genome
endpoints.describes: Available tracks for an assembly. trackLeavesOnly=1 hides parent groups so the response is a flat list (phyloP, phastCons, multiz alignments, ENCODE ChIP-seq, ...).

endpoints.label: Track data for a region
endpoints.describes: Track values for a coordinate window. For phyloP / phastCons conservation use track=phyloP100wayAll / phastCons100way. WARNING: response size grows with end-start; cap to ≤ 1 Mb per call.

endpoints.label: Reference sequence for a region
endpoints.describes: Reference sequence (FASTA-like JSON) for a coordinate window. Useful for breakpoint flank inspection in the cross_species_atlas.
